description: Verify gameplay rules and implementation coverage, localize reproducible defects, and validate repairs with scoped evidence.

codex.shortDescription: Verify gameplay rules, trace defects, and validate repairs.
defaultPrompts: Find the first tick where this reproducible gameplay bug violates an invariant.
Stress-test this gameplay repair with inverse and sibling cases.
Audit the affected behavior for implementation coverage gaps.

requirements: Defect localization needs a reproducible case and observable game state.
Turn-based verification assumes two players with strictly alternating turns and a pure engine contract.
